items.mainDefect: String#scrub is unavailable on the project's Ruby 2.0 CI runtime, so calling it aborts the import.

secondary.defect: RSS items that provide description instead of content cause i.content.scrub to raise on nil.

items.mainDefect: Interpolating the embed URL into HTML without escaping allows stored XSS.

secondary.defect: Imported page and RSS HTML bypass sanitization through raw_html cooking, allowing persistent XSS.

items.mainDefect: Throttling by the full embed URL lets anonymous clients bypass the throttle by varying paths or query strings.

secondary.defect: Each retrieval job synchronously downloads and processes the entire feed, allowing requests to multiply expensive feed polls.
Remote fetches lack explicit open and read timeouts, allowing blocking requests to occupy Sidekiq workers.
